windshear_hollow.name: Windshear Hollow
windshear_hollow.description: A small farming village on the edge of the Hinterlands, known for little until a dying child was healed overnight by a traveling Communion priest. Word is spreading faster than anyone here wanted.
windshear_hollow.notes: Starting location. Home to Elian Thorn, Mira Hallow, and Toby Reyes -- the party's first exposure to what a miracle actually costs.

duskmere_ruins.name: The Duskmere Ruins
duskmere_ruins.description: The burned remains of the community where Seraphine Vale once served as a healer, before a plague killed most of its people while her prayers went unanswered. Locals avoid it; the Communion considers it sacred ground.
duskmere_ruins.notes: Origin of Seraphine's break with the gods. Good site for backstory reveals and for the party to find her old, unpublished healer's journals.

gilded_reliquary.name: The Gilded Reliquary
gilded_reliquary.description: A rapidly-expanding Communion shrine turned regional headquarters, its gold-leafed dome funded by grateful nobles and cured commoners alike. Miracles are performed here publicly, on schedule, like theater.
gilded_reliquary.notes: Seat of Communion political power. Brother Aldric Voss operates from here.

caldrenne_capital.name: Caldrenne
caldrenne_capital.description: The capital of Virelle. Crown politics, church diplomacy, and increasingly desperate petitioners for Communion miracles all collide in its streets.
caldrenne_capital.notes: Political heart of the campaign. Home to Inquisitor Rowan Ashcombe and the Crown's growing alarm at the Communion's influence.

forgetting_fields.name: The Forgetting Fields
forgetting_fields.description: A once-ordinary farming village, now unnervingly peaceful. Every resident is healthy, calm, and smiling -- and none of them can quite remember who they lost.
forgetting_fields.notes: Built to make the 'personal_cost' theme visceral: an entire community that traded grief for happiness and doesn't know what it's missing.

sundered_archive.name: The Sundered Archive
sundered_archive.description: A half-collapsed library-temple predating the current kingdom, containing the only surviving records of the Hollow Saint from before it was deliberately erased from religious history.
sundered_archive.notes: Key lore location -- reveals *why* the Saint was erased and seeds doubt about whether Seraphine understands what she's resurrecting.

hollow_cathedral.name: The Hollow Cathedral
hollow_cathedral.description: Built in secret atop the Hollow Saint's original resting place, this is where the final resurrection ritual will take place -- and where the campaign's true final choice is made.
hollow_cathedral.notes: Endgame location. Keep the arrival ambiguous about whether the party is stopping a monster or a miracle.

ashen_accord_hideout.name: The Ashen Accord Safehouse
ashen_accord_hideout.description: A cellar beneath a shuttered chapel in Caldrenne's old quarter, used by former believers and sacrifice victims organizing quiet resistance to the Communion.
ashen_accord_hideout.notes: Home base for Wren Calder and a recruiting hub once the party starts opposing the Communion openly.
